text: Every month, lenders send the same reminder, at the same time, to everyone.
Kairos looks at every borrower, every day, and decides.
Before anything goes out, Aladdin, our safety supervisor, checks it against the lender's rules.
No reply on SMS. So it learns, and tries WhatsApp.
But even they can't break the rules.
To protect your account, I have sent a 6-digit code to your registered WhatsApp number.
Kairos answers in seconds. But only once it knows it's really them.
I already paid, here is the screenshot.
For your security, I can't help with this request in chat. A specialist from our team will review it.
A doctored payment screenshot? It checks with the bank.
You will not receive further automated reminders from us on any channel.
In our tests, about twice the money back for every rupee. With zero rule breaches.
